steps.name: The Wolf's Call
steps.objective: Meet the special young man in "Elias", then go to the Elias Royal Palace Guardroom.

lines.text: Continuing the story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The weather in Elias seems especially bright today.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A breeze warmed by the sunlight brushes past...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A young man on the roof of a house in Elias is looking down at the street.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He seems somehow familiar...)

lines.speaker: 청년
lines.text: Hmm...?

lines.speaker: 청년
lines.text: You're the adventurer the king mentioned.

lines.speaker: 청년
lines.text: Well, well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The young man looks at you, one corner of his mouth curling into a smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (His languid eyes leave an impression.)

lines.speaker: 청년
lines.text: (I see... Now I understand why he's interested.)

lines.speaker: 청년
lines.text: Heh. You're cute.

lines.speaker: 청년
lines.text: My name's Jeril. Remember it.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Sorry to call you all the way here. I have a prior engagement, so I can't exactly leave.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: You have the mage's ring, right? Let me see it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You hand Siam's ring to Jeril.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The ring glows blue in Jeril's hand, then returns to normal...)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: There. I've put power into the ring. Now you can add a new enchantment and use it.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Don't know what I'm talking about? All I was asked to do was charge the ring. Go ask at the royal palace in Elias.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Jeril snaps his fingers, scattering blue sparks.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A power that seems to belong to Jeril reaches you... You feel yourself being transported somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: ...Gone, then.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: A plucky little thing. Seems worth looking forward to.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: You can stop hiding now. Come out.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: ...What, did you change your hair?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: So you've finally said goodbye to that hip-hop outfit that never suited you.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: You idiot... What happened to you? What have you been doing with what little power you have left?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: You fought? That kid just now? ...Really? That strong? It wasn't like that when we were playing around with doubles in the Colosseum.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Anyway, if you still have something you want to do, be careful. If you get “reduced” before then, it'll all be for nothing, won't it?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: ...You and your gambling...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Fine, then. It's not as though I'd refuse your request. I'll see this through with you.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Wherever it is, I'll take you there.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Let's go meet the new pinnacle of light.
Continuing the story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The branches are so intricately tangled that you cannot tell where any of them began.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You try to head toward the trunk, but lose your bearings again and again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You decide to keep the trunk in sight as you move...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So far, you haven't found anything unusual besides the tree itself.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What if nothing changes by the time I reach the trunk...? Perhaps I should climb to the top and look down?)
No, I don't think you'll find anything special by looking from up there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Someone suddenly speaks to you!)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A boy with black hair... You have no idea when he came up beside you.)

lines.speaker: 소년
lines.text: Oh... I startled you, didn't I? Sorry.

lines.speaker: 소년
lines.text: It's my first time talking to someone other than her. I suppose I made a mistake.

lines.speaker: 소년
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The boy looks at you with evident fascination.)

lines.speaker: 소년
lines.text: Just as I thought—I have no idea who you are!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For some reason, he seems delighted...)

lines.speaker: 소년
lines.text: I can tell you're not one of “those who have opened their eyes.”

lines.speaker: 소년
lines.text: Are you from another world, perhaps?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You nod...)

lines.speaker: 소년
lines.text: Yes, of course...! So there really is more than one world...!

lines.speaker: 소년
lines.text: How fascinating... I wonder if I'll be able to visit another world someday...?

lines.speaker: 소년
lines.text: Oh, right. I forgot to introduce myself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The boy smiles, then adopts a solemn tone.)

lines.speaker: 소년
lines.text: Traveler from an unknown land, welcome. I am the guardian of this world, which has yet to awaken... Um... That is...

lines.speaker: 소년
lines.text: ...Trying to be formal is getting awkward and tiresome. Let's skip it. Is that all right?

lines.speaker: 소년
lines.text: I'm Odin.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: You have no idea how happy I am to meet you.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: My world is still small and unremarkable, but you're welcome here. Won't you tell me about yours?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You have met Odin.)
Continuing the story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You find the girl.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She is gazing into empty space, her eyes tinged with sorrow.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The World Tree around her feet seems faded, as though drained of life...)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: One of Odin's servants?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Her distant eyes suddenly sharpen, fixing you with a glare.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: ...Was there anyone who could awaken before the god of thunder...?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: It doesn't matter. I need only return the soul to flame and the body to frost...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: ...I'm sorry... You may curse me if you wish.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Did you imagine the glimmer in her eyes?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (In an instant, her shadow lengthens, and her form begins to change...!)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The claws of an enormous black dragon descend upon you!)

steps.name: Those Guided by the Valkyrie
steps.objective: Collect four types of weapons from the "Einherjar".

steps.name: The Two Eagles That Herald Destruction
A Dance of Dawn and Dusk
steps.objective: Talk to Odin at the "Urd's Spring".

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The black dragon spreads its wings wide, wraps them around its body, and returns to the girl's form.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: You are... so strong. You aren't Odin's servant, are you?

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Nor do I see a “shadow” cast over you, or “threads” binding you.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Who in the world are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For some reason, that is difficult to answer...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As you search for an answer, you give your name first.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Nii appears shocked.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: ...I know that name.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: You are the spark that will ignite Ragnarok in this little world.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: ...Iris's adventurer.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: I too exist to carry out her will...

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: I am not the one you must fight.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Your opponent is... this world itself. You must defeat Odin.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Please, hear me out...

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Odin...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Nii.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I've been to Mimir's Well.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Haha... What a surprise.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Odin...?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Every living thing has a destiny.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Destiny is the framework a consciousness chooses for itself. A way of living.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Though their forms differ, a god, a human, and a wildflower blooming in a field bear the same weight of destiny. All live by it, struggle with it, and die.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I thought it was the same for you, Nii. The nightmare of the World Tree, the black dragon that ends the world. I merely thought you were a little hasty, when the world hadn't even begun.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: ...But that wasn't it. Was it?

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Odin... I...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: In this little world, you alone, Nii, have been fighting for a true mission.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Isn't that right? Black dragon of “Iris.”

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: ...Don't make me laugh!

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I am Odin! The king of light who will build Asgard, lead the gods, and become humanity's teacher!

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Whoever Iris may be, I will not surrender this world to its heartless “mother”...!

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Nii... I'll give you the real battle you wanted.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A golden battle aura surges from Odin's body.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The air trembles and begins to rage...!)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Now... Ragnarok begins!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The battle with Odin begins!)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Odin plants his spear in the ground and steps back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The anger on his face has given way to emptiness...)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Let's stop... It was only... an outburst, anyway.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: An... outburst?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: ...Nii, you've misunderstood.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Even if you destroy me, this world will not disappear.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: And even if I defeat both of you, it will mean nothing.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: There is no way to stop the two worlds from colliding.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: No... That...

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: That can't be...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Nii sinks to the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Odin watches her for a moment, then turns toward you.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: There is one thing this world needs in order to awaken fully.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: That is <time>. And time is my domain.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: For a while, I will keep the world asleep, as it is now.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: That should hold off the catastrophe for a time.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: In the meantime, I want you to find the one who created this world... Iris.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Iris... The mother of the world...?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Nii, I have never been connected to her as you have, so I cannot know everything. But I do know that she is no “mother.”

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: As you already know, at heart she is an ordinary human... A pitiable being who somehow became entangled in the secrets of this universe.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: So I doubt that finding her will solve everything.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: But at the very least... We could try destroying her, to see whether all her dreams can be made never to have existed.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: You would... kill her?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: ...In any case, Nii and I are bound to this world. The choice is yours.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Now... You don't want to fall asleep with this world, do you? I'll send you back to your own.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Odin raises a hand toward you, and the world around you fades into a pale mist...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Odin's voice reaches you from far away.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: ...I thought we could be friends. I never imagined it would come to this...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: I'm sorry I grew angry when none of it was your fault. May fortune be with you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You leave Yggdrasil.)

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: ...Well, gone, then.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: ...It's astonishing, Nii. An ordinary human crossing between worlds and taking part in the fate of the universe.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Would the humans I had planned to create in our world have possessed such rich possibilities too?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Haha... I wish I could see them with my own eyes, just once...

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Odin...

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Nii, what will you do now?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: We could gamble on the slightest chance and burn Yggdrasil... The World Tree.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: If we forced open Surtr's domain and poured the river of fire flowing through Niflheim onto Yggdrasil, it could be done.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: If that is what you want, Nii... I will help you.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Odin... That's...

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: No. Even if we did, our world would not disappear.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: It would simply become a ruin ruled by death before it had even begun... And then it would collide with the other world.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: You think so too, don't you?

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: I... don't know anymore.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: Let me stay beside you.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: By your side... Until the day the world ends... That's where I want to be.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: ...Nii.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: ...If we can do nothing, and go nowhere, why were we ever born at all...?

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: It's so empty... Does our life have no meaning... at all...?
That... is not true.
There is meaning... Without a doubt... there is.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: This malevolent presence...?

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: ...We have many guests today. But a foul-smelling stray dog is hardly a welcome one.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Haha... Our young god is in quite a mood. A stray dog? That's a bit harsh for a wolf as beautiful as this one.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Bear with us. We haven't come to fight.

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: ...Who are you?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Hmm. This is... tough, even for me. Honestly, what business does an Agasura have visiting another world? Really...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: If we don't return to our own world soon, we'll be “reduced” in an instant.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Come on... Say what you came to say, then let's go. I can't promise how long I can keep you safe.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Young gods, please hear my friend out for a moment.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: Hear him out?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: A story.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: A story on which this unlucky gambler has staked everything...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: A story of hope.
